effective_policy: Applies after founder acknowledgment of the merged contract revision. Until then f32 cannot support comparative runs, scores or claims. Model-free instrument checks and isolated runtime preflight are development evidence only.
rationale: Register f32 downstream action utility with paired controls, observed-state grading, visible harm and damage, full lifecycle costs, isolated agent-authored memory and a bounded opt-in six-episode pilot. No catastrophic assertion or other-family denominator changes.
